claim: Dissolve the cornstarch in 2 tablespoons of water
Simmer it until it reduces by about half
Let the pot stickers fry until golden brown on the bottom
Slices of radish and a pinch of chives
Cooking mutton rogan josh in oil
Tuna mixture placed in line across one end of nori
whisk it all together until combined
Add sesame seeds, pepper powder, salt, lime juice, garlic, oil
Put the lemon juice, garlic clove, and salt into a little bowl and mix them together
Put olive oil and balsamic vinegar into a small bowl
Drain water, add cold water, place egg noodles in bowl, add oil, add oyster
Sprinkle with flour on both sides
